publicPreflight.title: YNX Chain — Web4 Layer-1 Ecosystem
publicPreflight.classification: wrong main-site shell; not the dedicated Wallet Companion

requiredReleaseTransaction.authority: Central Website/Integration owner with current Vercel alias lock
steps: Create a fresh clean worktree from the recorded main baseline or its reviewed successor.
Import only the frozen wallet paths and preserve every unrelated main path.
Run npm ci, Wallet Web test, build, package, verify-package, and the immutable PWA binding self-test on the resulting integrated main commit.
Package again with YNX_WALLET_WEB_SOURCE_COMMIT equal to that exact integrated main commit; do not reuse owner-branch binary artifacts.
Deploy a preview from the dedicated apps/wallet-web/public Vercel root and read back build-identity.json, sw.js, asset-integrity.js, PWA manifest, and exact bytes before any alias move.
Move only wallet.ynxweb4.com to the verified dedicated Companion deployment under the existing three-domain website lock.
Read back wallet.ynxweb4.com title, build identity, English default UI, no-store worker identities, and artifact hashes; retain the current 1018-byte shell identity for rollback.
Run the public PWA verifier against the actual alias and capture immutable deployment identity plus rollback receipt.
